svg.title: BeeBrain roadmap: the token launch era
svg.desc: Six milestones. Foundation built. Now launching BEEBRAIN on Solana, contract supplied. Next: bot reliability, evidence and API. Planned: wallets and Hive. Execution only after the evaluation gate.

g.text: A brain. A token. A hive.
Built before launch. Growing beyond it.
A learning bee for each chain
PROJECT PROCEEDS → DEVELOPMENT + SENIOR ENGINEERING HIRES
Milestones, not fixed dates. Real-money execution remains gated by published evaluation results.
